meta.source: Government of India crop-season classification (Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / ICAR) - standard Kharif/Rabi/Zaid system taught and used across Indian agriculture
meta.note: Exact sowing/harvest weeks vary by state and monsoon arrival; months given are the typical national window.

seasons.sowingWindow: June-July (with the onset of the south-west monsoon)
seasons.rainfallDependency: High - relies on monsoon rain, needs warm wet conditions
Low - depends mainly on irrigation and winter dew; needs cool weather

seasons.sowingWindow: March-June (short season between Rabi harvest and Kharif sowing)
seasons.rainfallDependency: Very low - almost entirely irrigation dependent, hot season
